author: Good Enough
description:
A wildfire can spread incredibly fast, trapping people with intense heat, thick smoke, and rapidly changing escape routes. Knowing when to evacuate, where to move, how to avoid smoke, and what to do if you become surrounded can greatly improve your chances of survival.

This Short explains how to survive a wildfire, what to do during a fast-moving forest fire, how to protect yourself from smoke and heat, and the biggest mistakes to avoid during a wildfire emergency.
title: How to Survive a Deadly Wildfire 🔥⚠️ #wildfire #outdoors #naturaldisaster #survival
